page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at top. Left margin: a marginal label "Quaest. XIII." beside the first line. Below: the paragraph, then the centred word FINIS, then a woodcut ornament, then the catchword INDEX at bottom right.

l.i: Nihil industria, nihil viribus meis tribuo, Totum hoc muneris tui est, Do-
mine, qui virtutem tuam in infirmitate mea perfecisti, & me caecutientem &
labantem Spiritu tuo direxisti, cujus gratia in solidum acceptum refero, si quid
hic à me praestitum ad Veritatis sacrosancte à Te nobis traditae illustrationem.
Sed quia frustra est qui plantat, & qui rigat, nisi addas incrementum. Da,
Pater optime, propter Christum dulcissimum Redemptorem meum, ut quales-
cunque isti conatus mei ad Nominis tui sanctissimi gloriam, & Ecclesiae tuae
emolumentum cedant. Da ut quantulum adhuc vitae[?] & vitae[?] mihi superest
divina tua misericordia transigendum, sub auspicio tuo, & gratiosissimo Spi-
ritus tui praesidio in Vocationis meae exercitio, & puro ac constanti Nominis
tui cultu decurrere valeam; donec tandem, peracto molestissimo vitae huius
itinere, in aeternam requiem translatus, Te Deum & Servatorem meum in
aeternum viventem & benedictum, in coelesti Primogenitorum Panegyri aeternis
laudibus celebrare queam. Tibi vero Regi seculorum, soli sapienti Deo im-
mortali, invisibili, Patri, Filio, & Spiritui Sancto, adorandae Triadi, sit

main_text.l: honor & gloria in secula seculorum. AMEN.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a vase with flowers) below FINIS is an illustration and is not transcribed. The marginal label "Quaest. XIII." is printed in the left margin and is recorded as a note. The words "vitae" and "vitae" after "adhuc" are hard to read on the scan and are marked [?]. The "AMEN" and "FINIS" are printed in small capitals and are reproduced as capitals.
